internal_measurement.results: Release-mode USI binary was rebuilt from commit 53cc137. Workspace tests, lint, formatting, the stdlib A/B-runner early-stop test, documentation-reference, public-surface, release-manifest, and cargo-publish-workflow checks passed. The USI smoke transcript reached usiok and readyok. This release fixes root mate-safety filtering before depth 1 in high-legal-move positions and adds bounded early-stop SPRT support to the local A/B runner. No local diagnostic is a formal strength gate or release strength claim.

external_opponents.configuration: No external-engine result is a release criterion or playing-strength claim for this maintenance and measurement release.

known_limitations: The mate-in-one-at-every-node candidate is intentionally excluded pending an independent long SPRT; it remains outside this release.
No NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted; the optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
External HalfKP 256x2-32-32 inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
